summary: Iteration 86 — Team Forms feature + roadmap 'In Development' rename. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (form CRUD, all 6 question types, coach upsert, tally 2 Chicken/1 Pasta → then public-parent switch to 2 Chicken/1 Veggie, share link create + public /api/public/s/<token> HTML renders, public submit updates tally, lock blocks both public submit AND coach upsert with 400, /remind Twilio LIVE returns 200 with {sent,no_phone,failed,url,token}, /api/roadmap contains 'Custom Team Forms' with status='in_progress'). Frontend: Team tab shows 'Team Forms' card → /team/forms; 'Banquet Meal' existing form visible under active season; create modal (forms-add → forms-name/desc → forms-create) opens form-detail; add-question flow (form-add-question → form-q-type-choice → form-q-label + form-q-opt-0/1 → form-q-save) renders 'Multiple choice · Chicken, Pasta'; Responses tab lists all 3 roster members (Ava/Bella/Cara), tapping opens response modal, tapping Chicken chip + form-resp-save marks green check with 'Chicken' summary; Tally tab shows '1 Chicken'; form-lock-toggle flips; form-delete cleans up; /settings/roadmap shows 'Custom Team Forms' card with 'In Development' badge and filter chip is 'In Development' (verified 'In progress' string does NOT appear anywhere on roadmap). All acceptance criteria met.

ui_bugs.issue: Console warning: 'A component is changing a controlled input to be uncontrolled. This is likely caused by the value changing from a defined to undefined'. Triggered when opening the Add Question modal — editingQ.label is initialized as '' but the value={editingQ?.label} can be undefined before state settles. Cosmetic React warning; functionality unaffected. Reference: /app/frontend/app/team/form-detail.tsx:266 (use value={editingQ?.label ?? ''}).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Emitted on every screen (login, team hub, roadmap). Not from this iteration's new code — likely a shared component. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up across the app.

action_items: (Optional/low) Guard TextInput value in form-detail.tsx line 266 against undefined: value={editingQ?.label ?? ''} to silence the controlled→uncontrolled React warning.
(Optional) Global pointerEvents deprecation — migrate props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents in shared components (not blocking this iteration).
